rule: Today's prompt = prompts[(local days since 2026-01-01) mod 30]. 'Show another prompt' moves to the next one. Mood is optional and never required to save.

prompts.prompt.01: What is one word for how you feel right now?
prompts.prompt.02: What are you grateful for today, however small?
prompts.prompt.03: What did you notice in your body during practice?
prompts.prompt.04: What would make today feel well spent?
prompts.prompt.05: Who made your day a little easier recently?
prompts.prompt.06: What is one thing you can set down today?
prompts.prompt.07: When did you feel calm today, even for a moment?
prompts.prompt.08: What is one small thing you mean to do today?
prompts.prompt.09: What can you hear right now? Write down three sounds.
prompts.prompt.10: What has been on your mind most today?
prompts.prompt.11: What is one kind thing you did, or could do, today?
prompts.prompt.12: What helped you through a hard moment recently?
prompts.prompt.13: What would you like to remember about today?
prompts.prompt.14: Which part of your day felt rushed? What could slow it down?
prompts.prompt.15: Describe a place where you feel at peace, in one line.
prompts.prompt.16: What are you looking forward to this week?
prompts.prompt.17: What have you learned from someone older than you?
prompts.prompt.18: Which family custom or tradition do you value, and why?
prompts.prompt.19: What would you say to a friend who felt the way you feel today?
prompts.prompt.20: What gave you energy today? What took it away?
prompts.prompt.21: What is one thing you're glad you did this week?
prompts.prompt.22: Write a line of thanks to someone you haven't thanked yet.
prompts.prompt.23: How did you look after yourself today?
prompts.prompt.24: What is something beautiful you saw recently?
prompts.prompt.25: What question are you carrying at the moment?
prompts.prompt.26: When did you last laugh? What was it about?
prompts.prompt.27: What would be enough, for today?
prompts.prompt.28: Is there something you're ready to forgive, in yourself or someone else?
prompts.prompt.29: Which festival or sacred day this season means something to you, and why?
prompts.prompt.30: Looking back over this month, what has changed, even a little?
